_readme: Hand corrections on top of the interest-category rules in
scripts/classify.ts. Keys are the club's slug from /studentgroup/<slug>.
Source categories are NOT overridable here — those come straight from the
directory's own headings and are authoritative. Only the inferred interest
Check any change with: npm run classify:report -- <interest-slug>

removeInterests._comment_incidental_health: Health words appearing once in a description about something else.
removeInterests._comment_incidental_environment: Mentions 'environmental' about conditions abroad, not sustainability work.
removeInterests._comment_incidental_law: Provides legal referrals as part of survivor support; not a pre-law group.
removeInterests._comment_incidental_finance: 'consulting' means consulting with faculty; 'financial' means financial aid.

addInterests._comment_cs: Real tech clubs whose descriptions avoid the obvious keywords.
addInterests._comment_law: A corporate law group the finance rules caught but the law rules missed.
